43.description: These tokens represent common German adjectives and participles expressing relevance, possibility, and distinction.

103.description: These tokens represent German auxiliary and modal verbs primarily used to indicate tense and mood.

111.description: This vector represents German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.

31.description: These tokens represent chemical prefixes, suffixes, and fragments used in organic chemistry and pharmacology nomenclature.

175.description: This feature vector activates strongly in response to terms related to pharmaceuticals, illicit substances, and medical conditions or treatments.

158.description: This feature vector represents common German adjectival and nominal suffixes as well as frequent suffixoid endings.

81.description: This feature vector activates for terms denoting notable, specific, or principal human figures, individuals, and related personal nouns.

20.description: This feature vector activates on German-derived prepositions, prefixes, and short function words, particularly those starting with vowels or common consonants like 'A', 'O', and 'D'.

37.description: These tokens represent indefinite articles and similar small grammatical determiners across different languages.

96.description: These tokens represent German modal verbs and auxiliary verbs used to express necessity, possibility, or permission.
